name: mmo-crypto-pvp
description: Browser MMORPG vertical slice with realtime PvP, monster farming, inventory and wallet claiming.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mmo/shared && npm run build -w @mmo/game-server && npm run build -w @mmo/auth-server && npm run build -w @mmo/blockchain-service && npm run build -w @mmo/client && npm run build -w @mmo/admin-panel
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w @mmo/game-server" "npm run dev -w @mmo/auth-server" "npm run dev -w @mmo/blockchain-service" "npm run dev -w @mmo/client" "npm run dev -w @mmo/admin-panel"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @mmo/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @mmo/game-server
